answer: Seal grades until the window closes. If a sybil ring controls several jury seats, its members want to echo one leader's score; sealed blobs leave each seat grading blind, so collusion needs an out-of-band channel that leaves traces. Then audit at random: when correlated seats keep missing ground truth together, slash them as a group. A sable cluster of identical voters becomes visible against honest scatter, and a reputation built that way turns into a relic of one bad epoch.
